headline: European Benchmark Natural Gas Prices Increase 4% to €84 per Megawatt-Hour
summary: Dutch TTF natural gas futures, the European benchmark, increased 4% to €84 per megawatt-hour in Amsterdam trading.
why: The Dutch TTF venue serves as the primary regional price settlement benchmark for European natural gas contracts.

impacts.name: Dutch TTF Natural Gas
impacts.why: Dutch natural gas benchmark contracts rose 4% to reach €84 per megawatt-hour.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
